# Easy Reps

> > Easy Reps is a free workout tracking app with 850+ exercises, no ads or signups, featuring iCloud sync and Apple Health integration.

The app provides comprehensive exercise libraries, muscle anatomy references, and educational content on strength training, nutrition, and recovery. Easy Reps integrates with Apple Watch, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro for seamless workout logging across devices.

## Getting Started

- [Easy Reps - Workout Tracking App](https://easyreps.app): Homepage: Free workout tracking app with 850+ exercises, no ads or signups
- [How to Start Working Out: A Beginner's Week-by-Week Plan](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/how-to-start-working-out.html): 4-week beginner workout plan with progressive bodyweight and cardio training
- [Your First Week at the Gym: What to Expect and Track](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/your-first-week-at-the-gym): First week gym guide: 3-day plan with cardio, machines, and bodyweight moves

## Exercise Library & Reference

- [Exercises - Easy Reps](https://easyreps.app/exercises.html): Searchable library of 850+ exercises filtered by muscle, equipment, level
- [Muscles - Easy Reps](https://easyreps.app/muscles): Interactive anatomy reference showing 16 major muscle groups
- [Pullups - Easy Reps](https://easyreps.app/exercises/pullups): Exercise guide: pullups technique for lats and biceps (beginner compound)
- [Hanging Leg Raise - Easy Reps](https://easyreps.app/exercises/hanging_leg_raise): Exercise guide: hanging leg raise for abs (expert bodyweight isolation)
- [Crunches - Easy Reps](https://easyreps.app/exercises/crunches): Exercise guide: crunches for abdominals (beginner isolation bodyweight)

## Workout Guides & Training

- [The Ultimate Back and Bicep Workout Plan for Beginners](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/ultimate-back-bicep-workout-beginners): Beginner back/bicep workout: lat pulldowns, rows, curls with form tips
- [How to Log Your PRs Like a Pro Bodybuilder](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/how-to-log-prs-like-pro-bodybuilder.html): Guide to tracking personal records for strength training progress
- [Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up: Complete Step-by-Step Guide](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/kettlebell-turkish-getup-guide.html): Turkish get-up tutorial: 7 phases for full-body strength and stability
- [Recovery Revolution: Sauna, Cold Plunge & Stress Management](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/recovery-revolution-sauna-cold-stress.html): Recovery guide: sauna, cold exposure timing for muscle growth optimization

## Nutrition & Supplements

- [All About Vitamin D: Your Guide to Strong Bones, Immunity, and More](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/vitamin-d-guide): Complete guide to Vitamin D: sources, dosage, deficiency, and supplementation
- [All About Vitamin D3: Your Guide to Strong Bones, Immunity, and More](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/vitamin-d3-guide.html): Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) guide: D3 vs D2, dosage, and sunlight exposure
- [All About Omega-3 Fatty Acids: Your Guide to Heart, Brain, and Beyond](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/omega-3-guide): Omega-3 guide: EPA, DHA, ALA sources, fish oil vs plant-based options
- [All About Vitamin B12: Your Guide to Energy, Nerves, and More](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/vitamin-b12-guide.html): Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) guide: energy, nerve function, vegan considerations
- [All About Vitamin K2: Your Guide to Strong Bones and a Healthy Heart](https://easyreps.app/blog-posts/vitamin-k2-guide.html): Vitamin K2 guide: bone health, heart health, MK-7 vs MK-4 supplementation
